verdict.rationale: Airweave offers webhooks that push event notifications (sync completed, connection created, collection updated) and a Pipedream integration that can trigger syncs from workflows, but there is no evidence of a native rules/conditions engine inside Airweave where a user defines 'if event X then action Y' logic — the actual triggering logic lives in external tools (Pipedream) or the user's own webhook consumer. missing for 10: a native rule-definition UI/API within Airweave, conditional logic support, and any documented example of an end-to-end automated action triggered purely by Airweave itself.
